product_one_liner.value: Nanonets provides AI agents that read, validate, route, and post document data to automate document-heavy workflows for enterprise finance, operations, logistics, and healthcare teams.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing includes per-run rates for operations and AI tasks.

named_customers.notes: Both appear on the product page's customer logo wall.

employee_band.notes: Y Combinator lists a team size of 102.

eng_blog.notes: Its research section includes OCR-3's architecture and training devlog and engineer Souvik Mandal's OCR-s model-training write-up.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation contains multiple guides covering APIs, data formatting, lookups, and workflows.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists a Deep Learning Engineer role in Bengaluru.

model_provider.value: Nanonets' proprietary Nanonets OCR-3; Qwen2.5-VL-3B is the base model for its Nanonets-OCR-s model.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims include SOC 2 Type II reports and ISO 27001 certification; GDPR is described as aligned, and a HIPAA BAA is available for enterprise plans.

last_funding.notes: Announced March 12, 2024, as a $29 million round led by Accel India.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent disclosed round was in March 2024, before the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The job board lists an Enterprise Account Executive role in Palo Alto.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Shubhra Mishra's profile lists a March 2026 start as Vice President, Strategic Initiatives at Nanonets.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Both are named integrations; this establishes integration support, not confirmed internal CRM usage.
